name: kernel_frame_journal

test_list.description: Publish an actual kernel event only after exact transcript CAS readback.
Retain and verify a real tool result from an interrupted attempt.
Reject invalid records without publishing an event.
Retain durable transcripts across restart and reject new closed-kernel records.
Drain an accepted blocking journal operation after its caller drops.
Property-check admission against exact JSON byte counts for arbitrary Unicode goals and output caps.
Debug output must not recursively expose kernel state or workspace paths.
Closed or queued admission cannot allocate additional prepared transcript buffers before obtaining the bounded owner slot.

inputs.name: binding
inputs.description: Sealed actual frame and root identity.

output_description: Verified durable transcript followed by actual kernel event publication, or an explicit failure.
